```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css"/>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/papaparse@5.4.1/papaparse.min.js"></script>

<style>
  /* ─── Hero ─── */
  .pa-hero { background: var(--map-navy, #3d3d3d); color: #fff; padding: 2.5rem 2rem; }
  .pa-hero h1 { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 2.2rem; margin: 0 0 .4rem; }
  .pa-hero p  { opacity: .75; margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; max-width: 900px; }

  .pa-wrap { max-width: 1500px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 3rem; }

  /* ─── Country picker ─── */
  .pa-country-bar {
    display: flex; gap: .75rem; align-items: end; flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: 1rem 1.25rem; background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--map-border, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: var(--map-shadow); margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  }
  .pa-country-bar label { font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--map-text-muted, #64748b); display: block; margin-bottom: .3rem; }
  .pa-country-bar select {
    padding: .55rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--map-border, #e2e8f0);
    border-radius: 6px; font-size: .95rem; min-width: 200px; background: #fff;
  }
  .pa-country-bar select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--map-red, #c9a227); }

  /* ─── Non-Tanzania fallback ─── */
  .pa-fallback {
    padding: 2rem 1.5rem; background: rgba(6, 182, 212, .06);
    border-left: 4px solid #06b6d4; border-radius: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem; color: #0e5460; display: none;
  }
  .pa-fallback h3 { margin: 0 0 .5rem; color: #0a1628; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; }
  .pa-fallback p { margin: 0 0 .5rem; }
  .pa-fallback ul { margin: .5rem 0 0 1.25rem; }

  /* ─── Section (one per map+table pair) ─── */
  .pa-section { margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
  .pa-section-header { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
  .pa-section-header h2 {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 1.35rem;
    margin: 0 0 .25rem; color: var(--map-navy, #3d3d3d);
  }
  .pa-section-header p {
    margin: 0; font-size: .9rem; color: var(--map-text-muted, #64748b);
    max-width: 900px;
  }

  /* ─── Map + table grid (2fr / 1fr on desktop, stacked on mobile) ─── */
  .pa-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr; gap: 1rem;
  }
  @media (max-width: 960px) { .pa-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  .pa-map-wrap {
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--map-border, #e2e8f0);
    border-radius: 10px; padding: 0.75rem; box-shadow: var(--map-shadow);
  }
  .pa-map { width: 100%; height: 500px; border-radius: 6px; z-index: 1; }
  @media (max-width: 768px) { .pa-map { height: 380px; } }

  /* ─── Toggle strip under each map ─── */
  .pa-toggles {
    display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding: .6rem .25rem 0; align-items: center;
  }
  .pa-toggles label {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem;
    font-size: .85rem; color: var(--map-text-muted, #64748b);
    cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
  }
  .pa-toggles input[type=checkbox] { accent-color: var(--map-red, #c9a227); cursor: pointer; }

  /* ─── Legend row ─── */
  .pa-legend {
    display: flex; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center;
    font-size: .78rem; color: var(--map-text-muted, #64748b);
    margin-top: .5rem; padding: 0 .25rem;
  }
  .pa-legend .lbl { font-weight: 600; color: #0a1628; margin-right: .25rem; }
  .pa-legend .swatch {
    display: inline-block; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 3px;
    margin-right: .3rem; vertical-align: middle;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  }

  /* ─── Right-side card panel ─── */
  .pa-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
  .pa-card {
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--map-border, #e2e8f0);
    border-radius: 10px; padding: 1rem 1.15rem; box-shadow: var(--map-shadow);
  }
  .pa-card h3 {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: .95rem;
    margin: 0 0 .75rem; color: var(--map-navy, #3d3d3d);
    text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }

  /* ─── Metric tiles inside catchment summary card ─── */
  .pa-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: .6rem; }
  .pa-metric-tile { text-align: center; padding: .5rem; background: rgba(201, 162, 39, .05); border-radius: 6px; }
  .pa-metric-tile .val {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 1.15rem;
    font-weight: 700; color: var(--map-red, #c9a227);
  }
  .pa-metric-tile .lbl { font-size: .7rem; color: var(--map-text-muted, #64748b); margin-top: .1rem; }

  /* ─── Tables ─── */
  .pa-scroll { max-height: 340px; overflow-y: auto; }
  .pa-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: .82rem; }
  .pa-table thead { position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--map-navy, #3d3d3d); color: #fff; z-index: 1; }
  .pa-table th { padding: .5rem .55rem; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; font-size: .75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .pa-table th.num, .pa-table td.num { text-align: right; }
  .pa-table td { padding: .4rem .55rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--map-border, #e2e8f0); }
  .pa-table td.num { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; color: var(--map-red, #c9a227); white-space: nowrap; }
  .pa-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(201, 162, 39, .04); }
  .pa-table .band-swatch { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 2px; margin-right: .35rem; vertical-align: middle; }

  /* ─── Status pill ─── */
  .pa-status {
    padding: .55rem .85rem; border-radius: 6px; font-size: .82rem;
    background: rgba(201, 162, 39, .06);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--map-red, #c9a227);
    color: #0a1628; margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  .pa-status.error { background: rgba(220, 53, 69, .08); border-left-color: #dc3545; color: #721c24; }
</style>

<section class="pa-hero">
  <div style="max-width:1500px;margin:0 auto;">
    <h1>Population and Access</h1>
    <p>Who each facility actually serves, and whether those people can realistically reach it. Population from WorldPop 2026 constrained at 100&nbsp;m; travel time from a modelled cost-of-access surface.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="pa-wrap">

  <!-- Country picker -->
  <div class="pa-country-bar">
    <div>
      <label for="pa-country">Country</label>
      <select id="pa-country">
        <option value="botswana">Botswana</option>
        <option value="ethiopia">Ethiopia</option>
        <option value="kenya">Kenya</option>
        <option value="malawi">Malawi</option>
        <option value="nigeria">Nigeria</option>
        <option value="tanzania" selected>Tanzania</option>
        <option value="uganda">Uganda</option>
        <option value="zambia">Zambia</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div style="align-self:center;padding-top:1rem;font-size:0.82rem;color:#64748b;">
      Full accessibility analysis is currently live for <strong>Tanzania</strong>; other countries are being processed.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="pa-status" id="pa-status">Loading Tanzania accessibility data…</div>

  <!-- Non-Tanzania fallback -->
  <div class="pa-fallback" id="pa-fallback">
    <h3>Full accessibility analysis for <span id="pa-fallback-country">…</span> is being prepared.</h3>
    <p>The travel-time + Voronoi-catchment pipeline currently runs only for Tanzania. The same methodology (modelled 100&nbsp;m travel-time surface, constrained WorldPop 2026, Voronoi catchments clipped to country boundary) will roll out to the other seven countries as country-specific inputs become available.</p>
    <p>In the meantime, per-country facility distribution and coverage are visible in <a href="registry.html">Registry Explorer</a>.</p>
  </div>

  <!-- ══════════════ Section 1: Travel Time ══════════════ -->
  <section class="pa-section" id="pa-section-tt">
    <div class="pa-section-header">
      <h2>Travel time to nearest facility</h2>
      <p>Modelled minutes-to-nearest-facility from every 300&nbsp;m pixel, classified into four bands. Fast on the green end, slow on the red end.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="pa-grid">
      <div class="pa-map-wrap">
        <div id="tt-map" class="pa-map"></div>
        <div class="pa-toggles">
          <label><input type="checkbox" id="tt-facilities"> Show facility points</label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" id="tt-wdpa"> Show protected areas</label>
        </div>
        <div class="pa-legend" id="tt-legend"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="pa-panel">
        <div class="pa-card">
          <h3>National access breakdown</h3>
          <table class="pa-table" id="tt-summary"></table>
        </div>
        <div class="pa-card">
          <h3>Worst-served districts <span style="font-weight:400;text-transform:none;color:#64748b;">(pop &gt; 60 min)</span></h3>
          <div class="pa-scroll">
            <table class="pa-table" id="tt-districts"></table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ══════════════ Section 2: Catchment ══════════════ -->
  <section class="pa-section" id="pa-section-cat">
    <div class="pa-section-header">
      <h2>Estimated facility catchment</h2>
      <p>Voronoi (nearest-facility) catchments &mdash; each polygon is the region of space closer to that facility than to any other, clipped to the country boundary. Non-overlapping, exhaustive; total pop across catchments = national pop.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="pa-grid">
      <div class="pa-map-wrap">
        <div id="cat-map" class="pa-map"></div>
        <div class="pa-toggles">
          <label><input type="checkbox" id="cat-facilities"> Show facility points</label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" id="cat-wdpa"> Show protected areas</label>
        </div>
        <div class="pa-legend" id="cat-legend"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="pa-panel">
        <div class="pa-card" id="cat-summary-card">
          <h3>Summary</h3>
          <div class="pa-metrics" id="cat-metrics"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="pa-card">
          <h3>Top 15 facilities by catchment population</h3>
          <div class="pa-scroll">
            <table class="pa-table" id="cat-top"></table>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

</div>

<script>
(function(){
  var DATA_BASE = 'data/population/processed';

  // Travel-time palette: green (short) → red (long). Matches the
  // accessibility semantic used by the R pop_access.R plot.
  var TT_BANDS = [
    { band: 1, label: '0–30 min',  color: '#1a9850' },
    { band: 2, label: '30–60 min', color: '#a6d96a' },
    { band: 3, label: '60–90 min', color: '#fdae61' },
    { band: 4, label: '>90 min',   color: '#d73027' }
  ];
  function ttBandColor(b) {
    for (var i = 0; i < TT_BANDS.length; i++) if (TT_BANDS[i].band === +b) return TT_BANDS[i].color;
    return '#9ca3af';
  }

  // Catchment quintile palette: sequential purple. Distinct from travel-time
  // palette so the two maps read differently at a glance.
  var CAT_QUINTILES = [
    { label: 'Very Low',  color: '#f2f0f7' },
    { label: 'Low',       color: '#cbc9e2' },
    { label: 'Moderate',  color: '#9e9ac8' },
    { label: 'High',      color: '#756bb1' },
    { label: 'Very High', color: '#54278f' }
  ];
  function catColor(v, breaks) {
    if (v == null || !isFinite(+v)) return '#e5e7eb';
    v = +v;
    for (var i = 0; i < breaks.length; i++) if (v <= breaks[i]) return CAT_QUINTILES[i].color;
    return CAT_QUINTILES[CAT_QUINTILES.length - 1].color;
  }

  function quantile(sorted, p) {
    if (!sorted.length) return NaN;
    var idx = Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.floor(p * (sorted.length - 1)));
    return sorted[idx];
  }
  function fmt(n) { return (n == null || !isFinite(+n)) ? '—' : (+n).toLocaleString(); }
  function fmtShort(n) {
    if (n == null || !isFinite(+n)) return '—';
    n = +n;
    if (n >= 1e6) return (n / 1e6).toFixed(1) + ' M';
    if (n >= 1e3) return (n / 1e3).toFixed(1) + ' k';
    return String(Math.round(n));
  }

  // ─── Two independent Leaflet maps ─────────────────────────────────────
  var TZ_BOUNDS = [[-11.8, 29.2], [-1.0, 40.6]];
  function newMap(id) {
    var m = L.map(id, { preferCanvas: true }).fitBounds(TZ_BOUNDS);
    L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
      attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors', maxZoom: 12
    }).addTo(m);
    return m;
  }
  var ttMap  = newMap('tt-map');
  var catMap = newMap('cat-map');

  // Per-map layer holders. Filled on first show-check; toggling reuses.
  var layers = {
    tt:  { bands: null, wdpa: null, facilities: null },
    cat: { catchments: null, wdpa: null, facilities: null }
  };

  // Data cache
  var data = {};

  function setStatus(msg, kind) {
    var el = document.getElementById('pa-status');
    el.className = 'pa-status' + (kind === 'error' ? ' error' : '');
    el.innerHTML = msg;
    el.style.display = 'block';
  }
  function hideStatus() { document.getElementById('pa-status').style.display = 'none'; }

  function fetchJSON(url) {
    return fetch(url).then(function(r){
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(url + ' → HTTP ' + r.status);
      return r.json();
    });
  }
  function fetchCSV(url) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject){
      Papa.parse(url, {
        download: true, header: true, skipEmptyLines: true,
        complete: function(res){ resolve(res.data || []); },
        error: function(err){ reject(err); }
      });
    });
  }

  // ─── Loaders ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function loadTanzania() {
    setStatus('Loading Tanzania accessibility layers…');
    document.getElementById('pa-fallback').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('pa-section-tt').style.display  = '';
    document.getElementById('pa-section-cat').style.display = '';

    Promise.all([
      fetchJSON(DATA_BASE + '/tanzania_travel_time_bands.geojson'),
      fetchJSON(DATA_BASE + '/tanzania_voronoi_polygons.geojson'),
      fetchJSON(DATA_BASE + '/tanzania_wdpa_strict.geojson'),
      fetchCSV(DATA_BASE + '/tanzania_access_summary.csv'),
      fetchCSV(DATA_BASE + '/tanzania_district_burden.csv'),
      fetchCSV(DATA_BASE + '/tanzania_catchments_voronoi.csv')
    ]).then(function(r){
      data.ttBands       = r[0];
      data.voronoi       = r[1];
      data.wdpa          = r[2];
      data.accessSummary = r[3];
      data.districts     = r[4];
      data.catchments    = r[5];

      renderTravelTime();
      renderCatchment();
      renderLegends();
      hideStatus();
    }).catch(function(err){
      console.error(err);
      setStatus('Could not load Tanzania data: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : err), 'error');
    });
  }

  function showFallback(country) {
    document.getElementById('pa-fallback-country').textContent =
      country.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + country.slice(1);
    document.getElementById('pa-fallback').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('pa-section-tt').style.display  = 'none';
    document.getElementById('pa-section-cat').style.display = 'none';
    hideStatus();
  }

  // ─── Travel time map ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderTravelTime() {
    if (layers.tt.bands) { ttMap.removeLayer(layers.tt.bands); }
    layers.tt.bands = L.geoJSON(data.ttBands, {
      style: function(f){
        return {
          fillColor: ttBandColor(f.properties.band),
          weight: 0, color: 'transparent', fillOpacity: 0.65
        };
      },
      interactive: false
    }).addTo(ttMap);
    ttMap.fitBounds(layers.tt.bands.getBounds());

    // Right side: national breakdown table
    var rows = (data.accessSummary || []).slice().sort(function(a,b){ return +a.access - +b.access; });
    var html = '<thead><tr><th>Band</th><th class="num">Population</th><th class="num">%</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      html += '<tr>';
      html += '<td><span class="band-swatch" style="background:'+ttBandColor(r.access)+'"></span>'+r.access_band+'</td>';
      html += '<td class="num">'+fmt(r.population)+'</td>';
      html += '<td class="num">'+(+r.pct).toFixed(1)+'%</td>';
      html += '</tr>';
    });
    html += '</tbody>';
    document.getElementById('tt-summary').innerHTML = html;

    // Right side: worst 15 districts by pop over 60 min
    var d = (data.districts || []).slice()
      .filter(function(r){ return r.district && r.pop_total; })
      .sort(function(a,b){ return (+b.pop_over60) - (+a.pop_over60); })
      .slice(0, 15);
    var html2 = '<thead><tr><th>District</th><th class="num">Pop</th><th class="num">&gt;60 min</th><th class="num">%</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    d.forEach(function(r){
      html2 += '<tr>';
      html2 += '<td>'+r.district+'</td>';
      html2 += '<td class="num">'+fmtShort(r.pop_total)+'</td>';
      html2 += '<td class="num">'+fmtShort(r.pop_over60)+'</td>';
      html2 += '<td class="num">'+(+r.pct_over60).toFixed(1)+'%</td>';
      html2 += '</tr>';
    });
    html2 += '</tbody>';
    document.getElementById('tt-districts').innerHTML = html2;
  }

  // ─── Catchment map (Voronoi) ─────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderCatchment() {
    // Quintile breaks over the polygon-level catchment populations
    var pops = (data.voronoi.features || [])
      .map(function(f){ return +f.properties.catchment_population; })
      .filter(function(v){ return isFinite(v) && v > 0; })
      .sort(function(a,b){ return a-b; });
    var breaks = [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8].map(function(p){ return quantile(pops, p); });

    if (layers.cat.catchments) { catMap.removeLayer(layers.cat.catchments); }
    layers.cat.catchments = L.geoJSON(data.voronoi, {
      style: function(f){
        return {
          fillColor: catColor(f.properties.catchment_population, breaks),
          weight: 0.3, color: '#ffffff88', fillOpacity: 0.78
        };
      },
      onEachFeature: function(feat, lyr){
        var p = feat.properties || {};
        lyr.bindPopup(
          '<div style="min-width:200px;">' +
            '<strong>' + (p.facility_name || '—') + '</strong><br/>' +
            '<span style="color:#666;">Region: </span>' + (p.admin1 || '—') + '<br/>' +
            '<strong style="color:#54278f;">' + fmt(p.catchment_population) + ' people</strong> in this catchment' +
          '</div>'
        );
      }
    }).addTo(catMap);
    catMap.fitBounds(layers.cat.catchments.getBounds());

    // Summary metrics
    var facCount = (data.catchments || []).length;
    var vals = (data.catchments || [])
      .map(function(r){ return +r.catchment_population; })
      .filter(function(v){ return isFinite(v); })
      .sort(function(a,b){ return a-b; });
    var median = vals.length ? vals[Math.floor(vals.length/2)] : 0;
    var max    = vals.length ? vals[vals.length - 1] : 0;
    var total  = vals.reduce(function(s,v){ return s + v; }, 0);
    document.getElementById('cat-metrics').innerHTML =
      '<div class="pa-metric-tile"><div class="val">'+fmtShort(facCount)+'</div><div class="lbl">Facilities</div></div>' +
      '<div class="pa-metric-tile"><div class="val">'+fmtShort(median)+'</div><div class="lbl">Median catchment</div></div>' +
      '<div class="pa-metric-tile"><div class="val">'+fmtShort(max)+'</div><div class="lbl">Largest catchment</div></div>' +
      '<div class="pa-metric-tile"><div class="val">'+fmtShort(total)+'</div><div class="lbl">Total pop served</div></div>';

    // Top 15 facilities by catchment
    var top = (data.catchments || []).slice()
      .filter(function(r){ return isFinite(+r.catchment_population); })
      .sort(function(a,b){ return (+b.catchment_population) - (+a.catchment_population); })
      .slice(0, 15);
    var html = '<thead><tr><th>Facility</th><th>Region</th><th class="num">Pop</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
    top.forEach(function(r){
      html += '<tr>';
      html += '<td>'+(r.facility_name || '—')+'</td>';
      html += '<td>'+(r.admin1 || r.admin2 || '—')+'</td>';
      html += '<td class="num">'+fmtShort(r.catchment_population)+'</td>';
      html += '</tr>';
    });
    html += '</tbody>';
    document.getElementById('cat-top').innerHTML = html;
  }

  // ─── Legends ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderLegends() {
    document.getElementById('tt-legend').innerHTML =
      '<span class="lbl">Travel time to nearest facility:</span>' +
      TT_BANDS.map(function(b){
        return '<span><span class="swatch" style="background:'+b.color+'"></span>'+b.label+'</span>';
      }).join('');

    document.getElementById('cat-legend').innerHTML =
      '<span class="lbl">Catchment size (quintiles):</span>' +
      CAT_QUINTILES.map(function(q){
        return '<span><span class="swatch" style="background:'+q.color+'"></span>'+q.label+'</span>';
      }).join('');
  }

  // ─── Toggleable layers ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Built lazily the first time the user checks the box, then reused.

  function buildFacilityLayer() {
    var group = L.layerGroup();
    (data.catchments || []).forEach(function(r){
      var lat = +r.latitude, lon = +r.longitude;
      if (!isFinite(lat) || !isFinite(lon)) return;
      L.circleMarker([lat, lon], {
        radius: 2.5, color: '#1f2937', weight: 0.6,
        fillColor: '#374151', fillOpacity: 0.75
      })
      .bindPopup(
        '<strong>' + (r.facility_name || '—') + '</strong><br/>' +
        '<span style="color:#666;">Type: </span>' + (r.facility_type || '—') + '<br/>' +
        '<span style="color:#666;">Region: </span>' + (r.admin1 || '—') + '<br/>' +
        '<strong style="color:#54278f;">' + fmt(r.catchment_population) + ' people</strong> in catchment'
      )
      .addTo(group);
    });
    return group;
  }
  function buildWdpaLayer() {
    return L.geoJSON(data.wdpa, {
      style: { color: '#2d6a4f', weight: 0.8, fillColor: '#52b788', fillOpacity: 0.35 },
      onEachFeature: function(feat, lyr){
        var p = feat.properties || {};
        lyr.bindPopup(
          '<strong>' + (p.NAME || 'Protected area') + '</strong><br/>' +
          (p.area_type || p.IUCN_CAT || '')
        );
      }
    });
  }

  function wireToggle(checkboxId, whichMap, key, builder) {
    document.getElementById(checkboxId).addEventListener('change', function(){
      var m = whichMap === 'tt' ? ttMap : catMap;
      if (this.checked) {
        if (!layers[whichMap][key]) layers[whichMap][key] = builder();
        layers[whichMap][key].addTo(m);
      } else if (layers[whichMap][key]) {
        m.removeLayer(layers[whichMap][key]);
      }
    });
  }
  wireToggle('tt-facilities',  'tt',  'facilities', buildFacilityLayer);
  wireToggle('tt-wdpa',        'tt',  'wdpa',       buildWdpaLayer);
  wireToggle('cat-facilities', 'cat', 'facilities', buildFacilityLayer);
  wireToggle('cat-wdpa',       'cat', 'wdpa',       buildWdpaLayer);

  // ─── Country switching ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  document.getElementById('pa-country').addEventListener('change', function(){
    if (this.value === 'tanzania') {
      loadTanzania();
    } else {
      showFallback(this.value);
    }
  });

  // ─── Initial load ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  loadTanzania();
})();
</script>
```
